description: Source code for the NetworkManager plugin implementation in WPEFramework, including initialization, deinitialization, and connection management.

classes.name: NetworkManager
classes.description: Implementation of the NetworkManager plugin handling initialization, cleanup, and connection events.

methods.name: ~NetworkManager
methods.description: Destructor, with cleanup handled in Deinitialize.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers notifications, configures network manager, and registers JSON-RPC methods.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications and methods, releases interfaces, and terminates connections.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles unexpected remote connection termination and triggers deactivation.
